collection.description: A villager sees children on the beach playing a game they invented as a child, with new rules.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) stops on the way home from work. Down on the beach, a group of children are playing a game with a coconut and three sticks in the sand. It's (subject)'s game. (subject.He/She) made it up as a child, with friends, a very long time ago. The rules have changed a lot. Someone is now allowed to shout "SWAP!" at any time.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) asks if (subject.he/she) can play. The children explain the rules to (subject.him/her), slowly, because (subject.he/she) is a grown-up. (subject.He/She) doesn't mention that (subject.he/she) invented it. (subject.He/She) loses badly, mostly because of "SWAP!", and has a wonderful time.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) sits on the sand and watches. The children play it faster and louder and better than (subject.he/she) ever did. When (asker), one of them, asks who made the game up, another, (kid), says, "Nobody. It's just always been here." (subject) smiles and doesn't correct (kid.him/her).
